scene: You step off the mountain cable tram into Hot Spring Terraces.
picture: Side-scrolling view of a stone terrace platform. On the far left rests the mountain cable tram with open doors. The player in lilac headscarf and mustard coat stands near a bubbling round wooden tub on the left. To her right sits a yellow snack cart, beside stone stairs on the far right leading upward.
shown: a circular wooden hot spring tub on the left bubbling with water
a bright yellow snack cart right of the player with steam rising
a carved stone staircase on the far right leading upward

variants.scene: The cable car brings you to a warm cliffside terrace bathed in dusk.
Lanterns glow softly as you search the mountain village for {quest}.
Sweet steam drifts from a food cart and the wooden hot springs.
